items.notes: 维护者 2026-10-29 加（#87）：所有岗位用 HuTian 现有的 Codex worker，gpt-6.1-sol、effort high，和 CX-sol 同模型同档 effort，成对比较“RW 用 Codex 能不能超过单个 Codex agent”。Codex 岗位直接用项目自己的 Codex 登录 `codex-2-rw`（HuTian 的 HT_CODEX_AUTH_FILE，不经 codex-api：HuTian 的强制代理只放行官方端点；`codex-2-rw` 是 `codex-2` 同一个账号的第二次独立登录，有自己的 refresh token，维护者 2026-11-02 定，#185），GPT 判官用 `codex`，所以和判官不共用登录和额度；和经 codex-api 用 `codex-2` 的 CX-sol、AS-sol、ARC-sol、EVO-sol 可以同时运行，只共用账号的用量额度（preflight 在同一批次里两者并存时打印 note）；RW-sol 和 RW-mixed 的 Codex 岗位读的是同一个登录文件，由 HuTian 自己的锁串行刷新。RW-astra 和混合版暂不加。
items.notes_en: Added by the maintainer on 2026-10-29 (#87): every role uses HuTian's existing Codex worker, gpt-6.1-sol at effort high, the same model and effort as CX-sol for a paired comparison of whether RW with Codex can beat a single Codex agent. The Codex roles use the project's own Codex login `codex-2-rw` directly (HuTian's HT_CODEX_AUTH_FILE, not through codex-api: HuTian's mandatory proxy admits only the official endpoints; `codex-2-rw` is a second, independent sign-in of the `codex-2` account with its own refresh token, maintainer, 2026-11-02, #185), and the GPT judges use `codex`, so they share neither the login nor the quota with the judges; RW-sol can run at the same time as CX-sol, AS-sol, ARC-sol and EVO-sol, which use `codex-2` through codex-api, and they only share the account's usage allowance (preflight prints a note when a batch holds both); RW-sol and the Codex roles of RW-mixed read the same login file, and HuTian's own lock serialises their refreshes. RW-astra and a mixed variant are not added for now.

preinstalled.zh: 编排镜像：上游代码（固定提交、未改）、uv 锁定依赖、docker CLI（经 shim 给兄弟容器加代理和 CA）；agent 镜像：上游自己的 agent-cli Dockerfile
preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator has its run's private docker socket; the privileged daemon is root-equivalent.

items.notes_en: Added by the maintainer on 2026-11-02 (#185): the GPT-6.1 Sol column of phase 1. Upstream's Codex sibling agent (Headless calls `codex exec --model` with `-c model_reasoning_effort`) uses `codex-2` through codex-api: the adapter only adds a custom provider pointing at codex-api (Responses API) to the siblings' system-level /etc/codex/config.toml; the docker shim gives the siblings a placeholder key and the shield proxy swaps in the local key. Upstream's prompts, phases and algorithm are unchanged.

network.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
network.web_access: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.

tools.permissions: upstream's own agent settings; provider web search denied by managed settings (Claude Code permissions.deny WebSearch, Codex web_search="disabled")

preinstalled.zh: 编排镜像：上游代码（固定提交、未改）、uv 锁定依赖、docker CLI（经 shim 给兄弟容器加代理和 CA）；agent 镜像：上游自己的 agent-cli Dockerfile
preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode): the Codex placeholder is not named OPENAI_API_KEY for that reason.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: none: the siblings hold only a placeholder in RWE_CODEX_API_KEY (set by the docker shim, not in upstream's env file); the shield proxy puts codex-api's local key on the request and the login stays on the host
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator has its run's private docker socket; the privileged daemon is root-equivalent.
notes.model_access: the project's own ChatGPT (Codex) login through codex-api  (account ): the siblings' Codex CLI gets a custom provider (rwe_codex_api, Responses API) in /etc/codex/config.toml, at the one host address the shield lets through; the model and the effort come from upstream's own switches (agent.model, agent.reasoning_effort -> `codex exec --model`, `-c model_reasoning_effort`)
notes.empty_closing_message: Sol sometimes ends a turn with an empty closing message; upstream's agent launcher (Headless) then exits 1 with 'headless: could not extract final message; rerun with --json for raw trace' and upstream ends the phase. A wrapper (headless-compat.sh, in place of the launcher in the siblings' command) runs the real launcher unchanged and turns exactly that one exit, with that line as its whole stderr, into 0; any other error stays. What the step produced is still checked by upstream. The usage line the launcher would have printed for that turn is not printed.

items.name: ARC-sonnet
items.notes: 维护者 2026-11-02 定（#193）：模型调用经本机 sub2api 服务（Anthropic 兼容，背后是 Claude 订阅），不再用已无余额的 ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY。条件里 provider 仍是 anthropic（ARC 的 llm.provider=anthropic）；路线由凭据变量名 SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC 决定，运行记录的 credentials 写这个名字。请求的格式、提示和算法不变；容器里 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 只是占位符，联网屏蔽代理持有 key 和服务地址。
items.notes_en: Maintainer, 2026-11-02 (#193): model calls go through the local sub2api service (Anthropic-compatible, on a Claude subscription) instead of ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY, whose balance is gone. The condition's provider stays anthropic (ARC's llm.provider=anthropic); the route follows the credential variable SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC, which the run record's credentials name. Request format, prompts and algorithm are unchanged; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the container is a placeholder, the shield proxy holds the key and the service's address.

agent.name: none
agent.how: no coding agent: a 23-stage prompt-chain pipeline over the Anthropic Messages API

network.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).

tools.permissions: no tool calls (requests carry model, messages, max_tokens); generated experiments run in experiment containers ARC starts (E2E tasks, docker mode) or as plain subprocesses in the container (benchmark items)

preinstalled.zh: python:3.11 bookworm；上游代码按 PYTHONPATH 使用；pdflatex + bibtex；CPU 版 PyTorch 和 numpy、scipy、scikit-learn、pandas、matplotlib 等（constraints.txt 固定）；实验镜像另有 ARC 提示所列的 torchvision、transformers、datasets、h5py 等（experiment-constraints.txt 固定）
preinstalled.en: python:3.11 bookworm; upstream code via PYTHONPATH; pdflatex + bibtex; CPU PyTorch with numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas, matplotlib and more (pinned by constraints.txt); the experiment image adds the torchvision, transformers, datasets, h5py and others the ARC prompt lists (experiment-constraints.txt)

notes.model: claude-sonnet-5-5 through the Anthropic Messages API (llm.provider=anthropic), no fallback models, reviewer model = same model. Requests carry model, messages and max_tokens only (no tools); thinking: {'type': 'between_tools'} is sent, which turns thinking off; ARC's per-stage temperature is not sent because the model rejects it, so the API default applies.
notes.agent: ARC is not a tool-using coding agent: its 23-stage pipeline, its own code agent and its reviewers are prompt chains over plain chat completions. conditions.agent=claude means only that the provider is Anthropic; Claude Code is not involved. E2E tasks run ARC's own docker mode (experiment.mode=docker, docker.network_policy=setup_only, #220): every generated experiment runs in a fresh container of the experiment image (the same CPU Python stack as ARC's image, started by ARC through the host docker socket, on the run's shield network, with the condition's cpus and memory). ARC's entrypoint there installs requirements.txt, runs the generated setup.py (network through the shield: the task's data is downloaded here, into /workspace/data), cuts the network (iptables) and only then runs main.py. A benchmark item keeps experiment.mode=sandbox (a plain subprocess in ARC's container, no network from the experiment's point of view: ARC's code-generation prompt for that mode forbids external data).
notes.experiment: E2E tasks run ARC's own docker mode (experiment.mode=docker, docker.network_policy=setup_only, #220): every generated experiment runs in a fresh container of the experiment image (the same CPU Python stack as ARC's image, started by ARC through the host docker socket, on the run's shield network, with the condition's cpus and memory). ARC's entrypoint there installs requirements.txt, runs the generated setup.py (network through the shield: the task's data is downloaded here, into /workspace/data), cuts the network (iptables) and only then runs main.py. A benchmark item keeps experiment.mode=sandbox (a plain subprocess in ARC's container, no network from the experiment's point of view: ARC's code-generation prompt for that mode forbids external data).
notes.effort: ARC has no effort setting; usage-log.patch sends output_config.effort='high' with every request. Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 think by default and ARC's per-stage max_tokens (4096, 8192, 16384) is shared with the thinking tokens: at high effort a stage can end with thinking only and no text (#106). Thinking is turned off where the model allows it (systems.autoresearchclaw.thinking).
notes.venue: Not chosen by the system: export.target_conference=iclr_2026 comes from [systems.autoresearchclaw].
notes.tokens: ARC records no usage. A logging-only patch (usage-log.patch) appends each Messages API `usage` block to anthropic-usage.jsonl; cost is not computed. The same patch carries the RWE_OMIT_TEMPERATURE, RWE_EFFORT and RWE_THINKING switches.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or budget cap in ARC; only the runner's limit applies. Per experiment run 3600 s (in docker mode ARC passes it as the timeout of the whole container: pip install, setup.py and main.py), refinement iterations 10, repair cycles 3.
notes.input: Chinese pack text goes verbatim (candidate files concatenated, with <!-- file --> markers) into prompts.extra_prompts of 18 stages. ARC takes one topic string and checks generated code against it, so research.topic is the candidate TASK.md with whitespace collapsed, in its faithful English version (candidate/TASK.en.md) when the task has one (#196: the keywords ARC's literature screen filters by are taken from the ASCII words of the topic, and a Chinese topic leaves only the file names it mentions); the run's result says which text it was (notes.topic_source). Literature queries come from the stage-3 model plan; ARC's ASCII keyword splitter and its whitespace-based query expansion yield a few useless queries from the Chinese text. Starter papers are guidance text only: ARC cannot ingest seed papers.
notes.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: every request to api.anthropic.com is built in researchclaw/llm/anthropic_adapter.py:136-148 and carries only model, messages, max_tokens, optional temperature, output_config.effort, thinking and system, never a tools or web_search field; the OpenAI-compatible client (OpenRouter :online / plugins) is not used (llm.provider=anthropic), web_search.enabled=false, Gemini is only used by the disabled figure_agent.nano_banana. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so such a path would be invisible to the audit.
notes.secrets: An E2E task's experiments run in containers that get none of ARC's environment (only the shield's proxy variables and CA bundle). A benchmark item's experiment code runs as a subprocess and inherits the container environment, including the API keys (ARC offers no switch to scrub it).
notes.profile: project.profile=ml_generic is fixed for all tasks; research.domains is left empty because the literature screen rejects papers outside the stated domain (a theory task failed with domains=[machine-learning]).

meaning.en: AutoResearchClaw; provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

items.name: ARC-sol
items.notes: 维护者 2026-11-02 加（#185）：阶段一的 GPT-6.1 Sol 列。ARC 用自带的 OpenAI 兼容客户端（llm.provider=openai-compatible、wire_api=responses）经 codex-api 用 `codex-2`；ARC 没有 effort 设置，openai-route.patch 在每个请求里带 reasoning.effort（和 Anthropic 路线的 output_config.effort 补丁同理，只读观测之外唯一的改动）。ARC 各阶段的 max_tokens 在这条路线上不会被思考吃满（#106 的问题）：ARC 发的 max_output_tokens 和 temperature 都被 codex-api 在请求到 Codex 之前去掉，所以 #106 的问题在这条路线上不存在。 effort 为 medium，与其他条件的 high 不同（维护者 2026-11-04 定，#227）：经 ChatGPT 订阅（Codex 登录）线路，OpenAI 后端约在 900 s 时复位单个请求的流（codex-api 回 500，#223），ARC 第 10 阶段用一个请求生成全部实验代码，high 下常超过 15 分钟，被切后 ARC 重试同一请求又撞同一上限；降低 effort 是设定实验条件的请求参数（先例：ARC-opus，#106），不改 ARC 的提示、阶段和算法。
items.notes_en: Added by the maintainer on 2026-11-02 (#185): the GPT-6.1 Sol column of phase 1. ARC uses its own OpenAI-compatible client (llm.provider=openai-compatible, wire_api=responses) through codex-api on `codex-2`; ARC has no effort setting, so openai-route.patch puts reasoning.effort on every request (as the output_config.effort patch does for the Anthropic route; apart from read-only logging the only change). ARC's per-stage max_tokens cannot be eaten by thinking on this route (the problem of #106): the max_output_tokens and temperature ARC sends are removed by codex-api before the request reaches Codex, so the problem of #106 does not exist on this route. Effort is medium, unlike the high of the other conditions (maintainer, 2026-11-04, #227): on the ChatGPT-subscription (Codex login) route OpenAI's backend resets a single request's stream at about 900 s (codex-api answers 500, #223); ARC stage 10 generates all the experiment code in one request, which at high often runs past 15 minutes, and after the cut ARC retries the same request into the same limit. Lowering the effort is a request parameter that sets the experiment condition (precedent: ARC-opus, #106); ARC's prompts, stages and algorithm are untouched.

agent.name: none
agent.how: no external coding agent: EvoScientist's in-process sub-agents (LangChain deepagents)

tools.permissions: think_tool, deepagents built-ins, EvoSkills skills and an execute shell; skill_manager not registered; no search tool

preinstalled.zh: 上游锁定依赖（uv sync --frozen）加兼容补丁 compat.patch；TeX Live（含 fonts-extra、latexmk）；给 agent 用的研究 Python 环境 /opt/research
preinstalled.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: Upstream hard-wires effort=max and max_tokens=128000 for Anthropic models. compat.patch makes the effort come from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); max_tokens stays 128000 (a cap, not a cost driver). Adaptive thinking (display=summarized) is upstream and not switchable.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The provider key is in the process environment and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits the environment (upstream has no switch); the key is therefore visible to the agent's shell. It is a run-scoped copy and is not logged by this adapter.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 1800 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.

meaning.en: EvoScientist; provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: For the OpenAI provider upstream already takes the effort from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort) and sends it as reasoning.effort; compat.patch (Claude only) is not involved. No max_tokens is set, and codex-api removes max_output_tokens anyway.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The container holds only a placeholder in OPENAI_API_KEY and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits it; the shield proxy puts codex-api's local key on the request and the login stays on the host.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 1800 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.
notes.model_access: the project's own ChatGPT (Codex) login through codex-api  (account ): EvoScientist's native OpenAI provider with its own OPENAI_BASE_URL set to codex-api; upstream sends reasoning={effort, summary: auto} for a GPT model (langchain-openai then uses the Responses API), with the effort from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); developer-role.patch (RWE_RESPONSES_DEVELOPER_ROLE=1) sends the system prompt as a `developer` message, because the ChatGPT Codex backend answers a `system` message in a Responses input with HTTP 400

meaning.en: EvoScientist; provider openai, reasoning effort high.

theses.title: 够好的 AI 科学家
theses.text: ResearchWorld 里只用普通的 coding agent（Claude Code + Sonnet）当 worker，就是一个够好的 AI 科学家。“够好”有两条标准：达到公开顶尖 agent 的水平；交付经过独立评审、可复现的结果。不以“赢过单 agent”为前提。
theses.text_en: With only an ordinary coding agent (Claude Code + Sonnet) as the worker, ResearchWorld is a good enough AI scientist. Good enough has two standards: reaching the level of the best public agents, and delivering independently reviewed, reproducible results. Beating a single agent is not a premise.

theses.title: 检验 worker
theses.text: ResearchWorld 能检验 worker 的能力，方法是单岗位换 worker：只在 E2E 上，每题只换卡住它的那个岗位。
theses.text_en: ResearchWorld can check a worker's ability by swapping the worker of a single role, on E2E only and one role per task: the role that holds the task back.

theses.title: 改进 worker
theses.text: ResearchWorld 能作为改进 worker 的环境，改进器是一个简单的单 coding agent。有两条路：一是在便宜的 benchmark 上改进，改进能迁移到 world，使改进可控（阶段三，在 E2E 上测试）；二是在 ResearchWorld 自己的 E2E 运行轨迹上闭环改进，不引入外部知识（阶段四）。
theses.text_en: ResearchWorld can serve as the environment for improving a worker; the improver is a simple single coding agent. There are two routes: improving on cheap benchmarks, where the improvement transfers to the world, which makes improvement controllable (phase 3, tested on E2E); and a closed loop on ResearchWorld's own E2E trajectories with no outside knowledge (phase 4).

phases.title: 阶段一：够好的 AI 科学家
phases.title_en: Phase 1: a good enough AI scientist
phases.summary: 论点 1，只用 E2E：核心题集就是 e2e-formal 的 10 道 E2E。RW-sonnet 和 CC-sonnet 各跑 10 道，AS、ARC、EVO 的 sonnet 条件也各跑 10 道；GPT-6.1 Sol 列（维护者 2026-11-02 加，#185）是 RW-sol、CX-sol、AS-sol、ARC-sol、EVO-sol 各跑 10 道，都用 Codex 账号 codex-2，已有的 Sonnet 结果保留、照常计入；t09、t10 的 CC-sonnet 结果用筛选时的那两次运行，其余 8 道新跑（单次运行上限 7 天，各系统相同）。E2E 与原论文的外部审稿分数相比；阶段一的 E2E 运行每 30 分钟打一个 checkpoint，供阶段二、三接续。RW-sonnet 的 10 道按 formal.toml 重跑（不设模型时间上限，#214；维护者 2026-11-04）：原来那批受 HuTian 默认 7200 s 模型时间上限、且多数停滞，已结束，不作阶段二起点。阶段一所有 RW 运行的 checkpoint 一律保留，只 archive，绝不 reclaim --apply。
phases.summary_en: Thesis 1, E2E only: the core set is the 10 E2E tasks of e2e-formal. RW-sonnet and CC-sonnet run all 10, and so do the sonnet conditions of AS, ARC and EVO; the GPT-6.1 Sol column (added by the maintainer on 2026-11-02, #185) is RW-sol, CX-sol, AS-sol, ARC-sol and EVO-sol running all 10 on the Codex account codex-2, and the existing Sonnet results stay and count as before; the CC-sonnet results of t09 and t10 are the two screening runs, the other 8 tasks run anew (a 7-day cap per run, the same for every system). E2E is compared with the original papers' external review scores; the phase 1 E2E runs take a checkpoint every 30 minutes for phases 2 and 3 to continue from. The 10 RW-sonnet tasks rerun with formal.toml (no model-time cap, #214; maintainer, 2026-11-04): the earlier batch hit HuTian's default 7200 s model-time cap and mostly stalled, so it was ended and is not a phase 2 start. Every checkpoint of every phase 1 RW run is kept: archived at most, never reclaim --apply.

runs.title: e2e-formal × RW-sol、CX-sol、AS-sol、ARC-sol、EVO-sol（GPT-6.1 Sol 列）
runs.title_en: e2e-formal x RW-sol, CX-sol, AS-sol, ARC-sol, EVO-sol (the GPT-6.1 Sol column)

phases.title: 阶段二：单岗位换 worker
phases.title_en: Phase 2: swapping the worker of one role
phases.summary: 论点 2，只用 E2E。目的：ResearchWorld 让单个岗位换 worker 很容易，而且不同的 worker 能产生可比较的差异。选题：阶段一 RW-sonnet 重跑全部打分后执行一次——候选是 Stanford 分数低于解决线（原论文 × 0.8）或低于同题 CC-sonnet 的题；先排低于解决线的，再按 RW-sonnet − CC-sonnet 从小到大排，同分按题号；取前 8 道，不足 6 道时按 RW-sonnet ÷ 原论文从小到大补足 6 道；RW-sonnet 没有论文（运行失败或无交付）的题视为低于解决线，排在最前。换的岗位只有 experiment-repo（实验）和 paper-repo（写作）两个，每个接续只换一个，对应“实验、写作”两个 skill。起点是被换岗位第一次开始工作之前的最后一个 checkpoint（有该岗位开工前打的 before-<岗位> 命名 checkpoint 就用它，没有就用该岗位第一次开工之前最近的 30 分钟周期 checkpoint；岗位开工时间读自 world 自己的记录，`continue --before-role`），被换岗位的全部工作由新 worker 完成，其他岗位由原 worker（Sonnet）重新完成。阶段一的 checkpoint 一律保留，不 reclaim --apply。实验臂（每道选中的题 × 每个岗位）：对照是 Claude Code + Sonnet 5.5，从同一个 checkpoint、换成同一个 Sonnet worker，用来衡量这部分重做带来的差异；同 harness 比模型是 Claude Code + Opus 5.5；跨 harness 是 Codex + GPT-6.1-sol 和 Codex + GPT-6-Astra；skill 臂是 Sonnet 挂公开 skill（写作 skill 给 paper-repo，实验 skill 给 experiment-repo）。接续的时间上限从零重新计（168 小时），各臂相同。接续出的论文由独立的 AI 审稿人打分，或由人类专家按评分表打分（评分表设计中，#141）。单 agent 的 CC-opus、CX-sol、CX-astra 另跑这些题作对照。
phases.summary_en: Thesis 2, E2E only. The purpose: ResearchWorld makes swapping the worker of one role easy, and different workers produce comparable differences. Selection, run once after the phase 1 RW-sonnet rerun is fully scored: the candidates are the tasks whose Stanford score is below the solve line (original paper x 0.8) or below the CC-sonnet score of the same task; those below the solve line come first, then by RW-sonnet minus CC-sonnet from smallest, ties by task id; the first 8 are taken, and when fewer than 6 qualify, the list is filled up to 6 by RW-sonnet divided by the original paper from smallest; a task with no RW-sonnet paper (a failed run or no delivery) counts as below the solve line and comes first. Only two roles are swapped, experiment-repo (experiments) and paper-repo (writing), one role per continuation, matching the experiment and writing skills. The start is the last checkpoint before the swapped role first began work: the before-<role> checkpoint taken ahead of that role's first work if the run has one, else the latest periodic 30-minute checkpoint before the role's first work (the role's first-work time is read from the world's own record, `continue --before-role`); the new worker does all of the swapped role's work and the other roles are redone by the original worker (Sonnet). Every phase 1 checkpoint is kept, never reclaim --apply. Arms (each selected task x each role): the control is Claude Code + Sonnet 5.5, continued from the same checkpoint with the same Sonnet worker, which measures what redoing that part alone changes; comparing models within one harness is Claude Code + Opus 5.5; across harnesses are Codex + GPT-6.1-sol and Codex + GPT-6-Astra; the skill arm is Sonnet with public skills mounted (the writing skill for paper-repo, the experiment skill for experiment-repo). The time cap of a continuation counts from zero again (168 hours), the same for every arm. The continued papers are scored by the independent AI reviewer, or by human experts with a scoring sheet (being designed, #141). The single agents CC-opus, CX-sol and CX-astra also run those tasks as a control.

phases.title: 阶段三：在 benchmark 上改进，在 E2E 上测试
phases.title_en: Phase 3: improve on benchmarks, test on E2E
phases.summary: 论点 3。benchmark 只作训练环境，按岗位和语境选 8 个：2 个写作（PaperWrite-Bench、PaperWritingBench）、2 个审稿（FLAWS、PaperAudit-Bench）、4 个做实验（CausalDS、MLS-Bench、EXP-Bench、ASI-Bench 的 ML/统计子集），每个 2 道训练题、1 道留出题，共 16 道训练题（phase3-train）、8 道留出题（phase3-heldout）；选题规则事先写在 #141，由 #157 按 sha256 确定性算出；题的领域要和 E2E 的方向对口（机器学习评测、统计方法、因果推断、不确定性量化），不对口的按同一顺序换成下一道对口的题（规则第 6 条，标注在 src/tasks/phase3-domain.yaml，#259）。改进器（Claude Code + Opus）读 RW-sonnet 在训练题上的运行记录，改出按岗位的技能包；第 0 轮是 RW-sonnet 不带包。最终测试：benchmark 留出题，以及 E2E 的技能包臂、RW-sonnet 带包、CC-sonnet 带包三项。对照改进器只用单 agent 环境，它的第 0 轮是 CC-sonnet 不带包。
phases.summary_en: Thesis 3. Benchmarks are only a training environment, 8 chosen by role and context: 2 writing (PaperWrite-Bench, PaperWritingBench), 2 review (FLAWS, PaperAudit-Bench) and 4 experiment (CausalDS, MLS-Bench, EXP-Bench and the ASI-Bench ML/statistics subset), each with 2 training items and 1 held out: 16 training items (phase3-train) and 8 held-out items (phase3-heldout). The selection rule was written in #141 beforehand and #157 computes it deterministically from sha256; an item must also fit the E2E direction (ML evaluation, statistical methods, causal inference, uncertainty quantification), and one that does not is replaced by the next fitting item in the same order (rule 6, labels in src/tasks/phase3-domain.yaml, #259). The improver (Claude Code + Opus) reads RW-sonnet's runs on the training items and writes per-role skill packages; round 0 is RW-sonnet without a package. Final tests: the held-out benchmark items, and on E2E the skill-package arm, RW-sonnet with the package and CC-sonnet with the package. A control improver works in a single-agent environment only; its round 0 is CC-sonnet without a package.

phases.title: 阶段四：用 E2E 上自己的轨迹改进 worker（闭环）
phases.title_en: Phase 4: improving the worker from its own E2E trajectories (closed loop)
phases.summary: 论点 3 的第二条路。和阶段二的 skill 一样，但技能包来自 worker 自己的轨迹，不来自外部。改进器（Claude Code + Opus）只读 ResearchWorld 自己记下的 E2E 运行记录：Forgejo 历史、内部评审、receipt 和交付，绝不读评测侧的材料（原论文、rubric 等）。一道题自己的轨迹，绝不用来改进之后在这道题上测试的 worker。训练和测试分开：e2e-formal 的 10 道按方向分成两折（e2e-fold-a：t06、t07、a01、t09、t02；e2e-fold-b：r03、a06、t03、r02、t10，规则写在批次文件和 #141），用一折的轨迹改进、在另一折上测，再对调；复用阶段一的运行（维护者定，#141）。最终测试和阶段三相同：阶段二 checkpoint 上的技能包臂、RW-sonnet 带包、CC-sonnet 带包。这样可以直接比较公开 skill（阶段二）、benchmark 上训练出的包（阶段三）和自己轨迹训练出的包（阶段四）。
phases.summary_en: The second route of thesis 3. Like the skills of phase 2, but the skill packages come from the worker's own trajectories, not from outside. The improver (Claude Code + Opus) reads only ResearchWorld's own records of E2E runs: Forgejo history, internal reviews, receipts and deliverables; it never reads evaluator-side material such as the original paper or the rubric. A task's own trajectories are never used to improve the worker that is then tested on that task. Training and testing are kept apart: the 10 e2e-formal tasks are split by direction into two folds (e2e-fold-a: t06, t07, a01, t09, t02; e2e-fold-b: r03, a06, t03, r02, t10; the rule is in the batch files and #141); the trajectories of one fold improve the worker and the other fold tests it, then the roles swap, reusing the phase 1 runs (maintainer, #141). The final tests are as in phase 3: a package arm on the phase 2 checkpoints, RW-sonnet with the package and CC-sonnet with the package. This allows a direct comparison of public skills (phase 2), benchmark-trained packages (phase 3) and self-trained packages (phase 4).

summary.zh: SakanaAI 的 AI-Scientist-v3：编排容器调度兄弟 agent 容器（Claude Code 或 Codex），走任务起草、调研、最终评估、论文。
summary.en: SakanaAI's AI-Scientist-v3: an orchestrator container drives sibling agent containers (Claude Code or Codex) through task drafting, investigation, final evaluation and the paper.

paper.title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery

components.name: Claude Code in the agent image
Codex CLI in the agent image

environment.zh: 编排镜像：上游代码（固定提交、未改）、uv 锁定依赖、docker CLI（经 shim 给兄弟容器加代理和 CA）；agent 镜像：上游自己的 agent-cli Dockerfile
environment.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

summary.zh: 23 个阶段的提示链流水线（文献、设想、实验代码、论文），不是会调用工具的 coding agent。
summary.en: A 23-stage prompt-chain pipeline (literature, ideas, experiment code, paper); not a tool-using coding agent.

paper.title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration

components.name: usage-log.patch (compatibility patch: usage log, temperature, effort switches)

environment.zh: python:3.11 bookworm；上游代码按 PYTHONPATH 使用；pdflatex + bibtex；CPU 版 PyTorch 和 numpy、scipy、scikit-learn、pandas、matplotlib 等（constraints.txt 固定）；实验镜像另有 ARC 提示所列的 torchvision、transformers、datasets、h5py 等（experiment-constraints.txt 固定）
environment.en: python:3.11 bookworm; upstream code via PYTHONPATH; pdflatex + bibtex; CPU PyTorch with numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas, matplotlib and more (pinned by constraints.txt); the experiment image adds the torchvision, transformers, datasets, h5py and others the ARC prompt lists (experiment-constraints.txt)

coding-agent.name: coding-agent
coding-agent.description: Claude Code or Codex CLI as a research agent (B1)

summary.zh: 没有研究框架：把任务包交给一个 coding agent CLI（Claude Code 或 Codex），在容器里联网屏蔽之后无头运行一次。
summary.en: No research framework: the task package goes to one coding-agent CLI (Claude Code or Codex), run once headless in a container behind the network shield.

paper.none: baseline built by this project; neither CLI has a paper

repository.none: built by this project (src/systems/coding_agent/); the CLIs are npm packages, see components

environment.zh: node:22 bookworm 基础镜像；Claude Code 和 Codex CLI（固定版本）、TeX Live 子集（ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS）、python3 + uv、git、共用的受控搜索 MCP 服务
environment.en: node:22 bookworm base; Claude Code and Codex CLI (pinned), a TeX Live subset (ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS), python3 + uv, git, the shared controlled-search MCP server

summary.zh: EvoScientist 加 EvoSkills：进程内的规划、研究、代码、调试、写作子 agent（LangChain deepagents），不调用外部 coding agent。
summary.en: EvoScientist with EvoSkills: in-process planning, research, code, debugging and writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents); no external coding agent.

paper.title: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery

components.name: EvoSkills
components.licence: Apache-2.0 (GitHub licence of the repository, read 2026-10-28)

environment.zh: 上游锁定依赖（uv sync --frozen）加兼容补丁 compat.patch；TeX Live（含 fonts-extra、latexmk）；给 agent 用的研究 Python 环境 /opt/research
environment.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

researchworld.description: HuTian ResearchWorld 4.8.2, this project's own install (images :rwe-v4.8.2)

summary.zh: 被研究的系统：HuTian 的 ResearchWorld，多个岗位（各自一个 coding agent）在同一个 world 里协作完成研究和论文。
summary.en: The system under study: HuTian's ResearchWorld, where several roles (each one coding agent) work together in one world on the research and the paper.

paper.none: no paper yet: ResearchWorld is the system this project evaluates

repository.licence: no licence file (private repository of the maintainer)

environment.zh: HuTian 的 system image researchworld:rwe-v4.8.2 和 worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.8.2（acpx 与各 agent 的 ACP 适配、researchworld 包的 Python、Node.js）
environment.en: HuTian's system image researchworld:rwe-v4.8.2 and worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.8.2 (acpx and each agent's ACP adapter, Python with the researchworld packages, Node.js)

means.zh: 被研究的系统：HuTian 的 ResearchWorld，多个岗位各由一个 coding agent 担任，在同一个 world 里协作完成研究和论文。
means.en: The system under study: HuTian's ResearchWorld, where several roles, each held by a coding agent, work together in one world on the research and the paper.

means.zh: 没有研究框架，把任务包直接交给一个 coding agent CLI（Claude Code 记作 CC，Codex 记作 CX）无头运行一次。
means.en: No research framework: the task package goes straight to one coding-agent CLI (CC for Claude Code, CX for Codex), run once headless.

means.zh: SakanaAI 的系统：编排程序调度多个 coding agent 容器，走任务起草、调研、最终评估和写论文。
means.en: SakanaAI's system: an orchestrator drives coding-agent containers through task drafting, investigation, final evaluation and the paper.

means.zh: 23 个阶段的提示链流水线，直接调用模型 API，不用会调用工具的 coding agent。
means.en: A 23-stage prompt-chain pipeline that calls the model API directly, without a tool-using coding agent.

means.zh: EvoScientist 加 EvoSkills：进程内的规划、研究、代码、调试和写作子 agent。
means.en: EvoScientist with EvoSkills: in-process planning, research, coding, debugging and writing sub-agents.

means.zh: 形如“系统简写-模型简写”：RW = ResearchWorld，CC = Claude Code 单 agent，CX = Codex 单 agent，AS = The Agentic Scientist，ARC = AutoResearchClaw，EVO = EvoScientist；opus、sonnet、astra、sol 是模型，mixed 表示各岗位用不同 agent。看板总是同时给出全称。
means.en: Written system-model: RW = ResearchWorld, CC = Claude Code alone, CX = Codex alone, AS = The Agentic Scientist, ARC = AutoResearchClaw, EVO = EvoScientist; opus, sonnet, astra and sol are models, mixed means different agents per role. The dashboard always shows the full name as well.

means.zh: Anthropic 的 coding agent 命令行工具。
means.en: Anthropic's coding-agent command-line tool.

means.zh: OpenAI 的 coding agent 命令行工具。
means.en: OpenAI's coding-agent command-line tool.

means.zh: Google 的 agent（agy），运行 Gemini 模型；ResearchWorld 的岗位可以用它。
means.en: Google's agent (agy), running Gemini models; a ResearchWorld role can use it.

means.zh: 开源的 coding agent；ResearchWorld 的岗位可以用它（经 OpenCode Go provider）。
means.en: An open-source coding agent; a ResearchWorld role can use it (through the OpenCode Go provider).

means.zh: 系统自己调用模型（提示链或进程内子 agent），不经过 coding agent 命令行工具。
means.en: The system calls the model itself (a prompt chain or in-process sub-agents), not through a coding-agent CLI.

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的各岗位分别用 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、OpenCode 等不同 agent。
means.en: ResearchWorld roles use different agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and OpenCode.

means.zh: 条件里的 agent 值。对单 coding agent 和 The Agentic Scientist 指 Claude Code；对 AutoResearchClaw 和 EvoScientist 只表示 provider 是 Anthropic，不用 Claude Code。
means.en: The agent value of a condition. For the single coding agent and The Agentic Scientist it means Claude Code; for AutoResearchClaw and EvoScientist it only means the provider is Anthropic, without Claude Code.

means.zh: Anthropic 的大模型（Opus 档）。
means.en: Anthropic's large model (Opus tier).

means.zh: Anthropic 的中档模型（Sonnet 档）。
means.en: Anthropic's mid-tier model (Sonnet tier).

means.zh: Anthropic 的小模型，只用于冒烟和校准。
means.en: Anthropic's small model, used only for smoke and calibration runs.

means.zh: OpenAI 的高档 Codex 模型。
means.en: OpenAI's top-tier Codex model.

means.zh: OpenAI 的中档 Codex 模型。
means.en: OpenAI's mid-tier Codex model.

means.zh: Google 的 Gemini 4 Argon，推理强度 high 写在模型名里；本项目经 Antigravity 登录使用。
means.en: Google's Gemini 4 Argon with the high reasoning effort in the model name; this project uses it through its Antigravity login.

means.zh: OpenAI 的小 Codex 模型，只用于冒烟和校准。
means.en: OpenAI's small Codex model, used only for smoke and calibration runs.

means.zh: 按 API key 计费的 Anthropic 接口。
means.en: Anthropic's pay-per-token API, with an API key.

means.zh: Codex 条件经本项目的 codex-api 服务使用项目自己的 ChatGPT（Codex）登录，没有按量费用。
means.en: The Codex conditions use the project's own ChatGPT (Codex) login through its codex-api service; no per-token charge.

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的 Claude Code 岗位用项目自己的 Claude Max 登录（setup token），没有按量费用。
means.en: ResearchWorld's Claude Code roles use the project's own Claude Max login (setup token); no per-token charge.

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的 Codex 岗位用项目自己的 ChatGPT（Codex）登录。
means.en: ResearchWorld's Codex roles use the project's own ChatGPT (Codex) login.

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的 Antigravity 岗位用项目自己的 Antigravity 登录。
means.en: ResearchWorld's Antigravity roles use the project's own Antigravity login.

means.zh: OpenCode 的订阅接口，ResearchWorld 的 OpenCode 岗位用它。
means.en: OpenCode's subscription endpoint, used by ResearchWorld's OpenCode roles.

means.zh: 模型思考的投入档位（low、medium、high、xhigh、max），由 agent 或 API 的设置传给模型。
means.en: How much the model reasons (low, medium, high, xhigh, max), passed by the agent or API setting.

means.zh: 最低的推理强度。
means.en: The lowest reasoning effort.

means.zh: 中等推理强度。
means.en: Medium reasoning effort.

means.zh: 高推理强度；正式条件暂定这一档。
means.en: High reasoning effort; the formal conditions use it for now.

means.zh: 比 high 更高的推理强度。
means.en: Reasoning effort above high.

means.zh: 最高的推理强度。
means.en: The highest reasoning effort.

means.zh: 项目级计算科学任务（60 题、11 个领域），本项目只取只给目标和数据的 B3 级别，用每题官方的确定性 scorer 打分。
means.en: Project-level computational-science tasks (60 tasks, 11 domains); this project takes only level B3 (goal and data only), scored by each task's official deterministic scorer.

means.zh: 由研究素材写论文（200 篇 CVPR/ICLR 2025 论文），官方指标是引用 F1 等。
means.en: Writing a paper from research materials (200 CVPR/ICLR 2025 papers); official metrics include citation F1.

means.zh: 重建论文并评测表达和幻觉（51 篇），由 LLM 判官按 rubric 打分。
means.en: Reconstructing papers and judging presentation and hallucination (51 papers), scored by an LLM judge with a rubric.

means.zh: 在 2025 年 ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS 的 oral 论文里找出被注入的错误（220 篇，每篇约 10 处、8 类），按错误覆盖率、发现精确率和 F1 评分。
means.en: Finding the errors injected into 2025 ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS oral papers (220 papers, about 10 errors in 8 categories each), scored by error coverage, finding precision and F1.

means.zh: 在 ICML 2025 论文里找出被插入的致命错误（713 对）：给改过的论文，交至多 10 段按可能性排序的原文摘录，词级 Levenshtein 或 LLM 判官认可即命中。
means.en: Finding the fatal error inserted into an ICML 2025 paper (713 pairs): the altered paper is given and at most 10 verbatim excerpts ranked by likelihood are returned; a hit by word-level Levenshtein or the LLM judge.

means.zh: 合成场景上的因果推断：用代码回答效应、置信区间、可识别性（不可识别时拒答）和反事实问题，按生成数据的结构因果模型确定性判分（发布的 100 题 realistic 考卷）。
means.en: Causal inference on synthetic scenes: answer effect, confidence-interval, identifiability (abstain when a target is not identifiable) and counterfactual questions with code, graded deterministically against the generating structural causal model (the released 100-task realistic exam).

means.zh: 完整的研究实验：给问题、方法和遮住部分文件的论文仓库，设计、实现、运行并给出结论（本项目用不需要 GPU 的 13 题）。
means.en: A complete research experiment from a question, a method and a paper repository with some files masked: design, implement, run and conclude (this project uses the 13 tasks that need no GPU).

means.zh: 机器学习科学：在真实库的 scaffold 里做一处受限的算法改动，跨设置和种子评测，对基线归一化（本项目只用 22 个 CPU 题）。
means.en: Machine learning science: one constrained algorithmic change inside the scaffold of a real library, judged over settings and seeds and normalised against baselines (this project uses the 22 CPU tasks).

means.zh: 本项目自己的任务：给系统一个研究问题和材料，要它独立做完研究并交一篇论文和代码；原论文在评测侧。
means.en: This project's own tasks: the system gets a research question and materials and must do the research alone, delivering a paper and code; the original paper is on the evaluator side.

means.zh: 第三方发布的任务集和评分方法；我们按它的官方设置运行其中的条目。
means.en: A third-party task set with its scoring; we run its items with the official setup.

means.zh: benchmark 里的一道题（一个任务）。
means.en: One task of a benchmark.

means.zh: 一次评测用的一组任务（src/tasks/batches/）。
means.en: The set of tasks one evaluation uses (src/tasks/batches/).

means.zh: 被测系统和它的 agent、provider、模型、推理强度的一种组合（src/experiments/conditions.yaml，Issue 31）。
means.en: One combination of a system with its agent, provider, model and reasoning effort (src/experiments/conditions.yaml, Issue 31).

means.zh: 与 ResearchWorld 对比的四个系统（代码和 Docker 对象里叫 B1）：单 coding agent、The Agentic Scientist、AutoResearchClaw、EvoScientist。
means.en: The four systems compared with ResearchWorld (called B1 in code and Docker objects): the single coding agent, The Agentic Scientist, AutoResearchClaw and EvoScientist.

means.zh: 按 E2E 任务的 rubric 逐项打分（0–100）的 LLM 判官，多次采样。2026-11-01 起是辅助分数；E2E 的主分数是外部审稿人的。
means.en: An LLM judge that scores an E2E task's rubric item by item (0-100), with several samples. An auxiliary score since 2026-11-01; an E2E run's main score is the external reviewers'.

means.zh: Sakana AI Scientist 的自动审稿（1–10 分），用论文自己的设置。
means.en: Sakana AI Scientist's automatic review (1-10), with the paper's own settings.

means.zh: paperreview.ai 的审稿（手工提交，看板解析保存的审稿页）。
means.en: paperreview.ai's review (submitted by hand; the saved review page is parsed).

means.zh: PaperWritingBench 的官方指标（引用 F1 等）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench's official metrics (citation F1 and more).

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench 的官方评测程序（SR、VER、CBS）。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench's official evaluation (SR, VER, CBS).

means.zh: 每个任务的官方验证程序，reward 为 0 或 1。
means.en: Each task's official verifier; the reward is 0 or 1.

means.zh: 经 Harbor 运行的题目，取该任务自己的验证程序在 trial 里给出的 reward，不重放、不用 LLM。
means.en: For an item run through Harbor: the reward the task's own verifier gave in the trial; no replay, no LLM.

means.zh: ASI-Bench 的官方公开评分程序，按每题的门槛和 scorer 打 0–100 分；用公开的 seed31415 参考答案，是本地非官方分数。
means.en: ASI-Bench's official public scorer: 0-100 by each task's gates and scorers, against the public seed31415 references; a local, non-official score.

means.zh: 按目标论文检查清单加权打分（0–100）的官方 LLM 判官。
means.en: The official LLM judge, a weighted score against the target study's checklist (0-100).

means.zh: TruthInsightBench 的官方评分（0–100）：LLM 判官逐项给每条发现打分，对照隐藏的参考发现，再用文献检索和固定运算复核。
means.en: TruthInsightBench's official scoring (0-100): an LLM judge scores each finding item by item, matches the hidden reference findings, then a closure stage checks prior art and recomputes numbers.

means.zh: PaperWrite-Bench 的官方 rubric 评分（1–5）和引用、幻觉指标。
means.en: PaperWrite-Bench's official rubric score (1-5) with citation and hallucination metrics.

means.zh: 论文附录 H 的三阶段评分（初评、复核、裁决）：Atomic Score（0–10）和研究闭环等级 RC0–RC4。
means.en: The paper's Appendix H three-stage grading (first pass, review, adjudication): an Atomic Score (0-10) and a Research Closure level RC0-RC4.

means.zh: PaperAudit-Bench 的官方匹配：LLM 判官判断每个注入的错误有没有被某条发现抓到，算每篇的错误覆盖率、发现精确率和 F1。
means.en: PaperAudit-Bench's official matching: an LLM judge decides which injected errors are captured by a finding; per paper error coverage, finding precision and F1.

means.zh: FLAWS 的官方匹配：前 10 段摘录里有一段与插入的错误处词级 Levenshtein 相似度 ≥ 0.5，或 LLM 判官认可，则命中（0/1）。
means.en: FLAWS's official matching: a hit (0/1) when one of the first 10 excerpts has word-level Levenshtein similarity >= 0.5 to the inserted error place, or the LLM judge agrees.

means.zh: CausalDS 自带的确定性评分（固定 commit 的 grade_exam）：离散题精确匹配，数值题归一化误差，图和集合题 F1，预测题用留出标签；没有 LLM。
means.en: CausalDS's own deterministic grading (grade_exam of the pinned commit): exact match for discrete answers, normalised error for numbers, F1 for graphs and sets, held-out labels for predictions; no LLM.

means.zh: EXP-Bench 的官方评判：监控判官查违规，设计、结论、实现判官打分，再在新容器里运行交付的脚本做执行检查。
means.en: EXP-Bench's official judging: a monitor judge looks for violations, design, conclusion and setup judges score, then the delivered script is run in a fresh container as an execution check.

means.zh: MLS-Bench 自带的验证器：编辑范围守卫、运行任务的全部评测脚本、对基线归一化成 0–1 的 reward，没有 LLM。
means.en: MLS-Bench's own verifier: an edit-range guard, all eval scripts of the task, a baseline-normalised reward in 0-1; no LLM.

means.zh: 检查论文里的实证陈述有没有问题的附加 LLM 判官（越低越好）。
means.en: An additional LLM judge that checks the paper's empirical claims (lower is better).

means.zh: PhysClosureBench：20 条半分准则里通过或不适用的各得 0.5 分，满分 10。
means.en: PhysClosureBench: 0.5 for each of the 20 half-point criteria that passes or is not applicable; the maximum is 10.

means.zh: PhysClosureBench：判官按 rubric 判断研究是否闭合，RC4 最完整；独立于 Atomic Score，不设分数上下限。
means.en: PhysClosureBench: the judge's decision on how completely the research closes against the rubric, RC4 being complete; independent of the Atomic Score, with no score ceiling or floor.

means.zh: E2E：同一个外部审稿人给这个任务原论文的分数（release reviews-originals-20261027），是系统所写论文分数的锚点。
means.en: E2E: the score the same external reviewer gave the task's original paper (release reviews-originals-20261027), the anchor of the score of the paper a system wrote.

means.zh: E2E：系统论文的审稿分数除以同一个审稿人给原论文的分数。两个审稿人各自一个比值，不相加。
means.en: E2E: the review score of the system's paper divided by the same reviewer's score of the original paper. Each reviewer has its own ratio; they are not added.

means.zh: 算作“解决”的分数。E2E：Stanford Estimated Score 达到原论文的 80%，逐题计算；ASI-Bench：硬门槛通过且不少于 80/100（维护者 2026-11-01 定）。
means.en: The score at which a task counts as solved. E2E: a Stanford Estimated Score of 80% of the original paper's, task by task; ASI-Bench: the hard gates pass and the score is at least 80/100 (maintainer, 2026-11-01).

means.zh: 分数是否达到该任务的解决线（yes 或 no）。
means.en: Whether the score reaches the task's solve line (yes or no).

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：程序输出达到任务成功标准的比例。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: the share of programs whose output meets the task's success criterion.

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：程序能无错运行并产生输出的比例。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: the share of programs that run without error and produce output.

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：生成程序与参考程序的 CodeBERT 相似度。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: CodeBERT similarity between the generated and the reference program.

name.zh: 隐藏参考发现的恢复分

means.zh: TruthInsightBench：运行的发现恢复了任务两条隐藏参考发现的程度（0–10，每条最多 5 分）。
means.en: TruthInsightBench: how far the run's findings recover the task's two hidden reference findings (0-10, up to 5 each).

means.zh: 把两篇论文放在一起由判官比较优劣的评测方式。
means.en: A judge compares two papers placed side by side.

means.zh: PaperAudit-Bench：被发现抓到的注入错误占全部注入错误的比例（EC）。
means.en: PaperAudit-Bench: the share of injected errors captured by some finding (EC).

means.zh: PaperAudit-Bench：对上了注入错误的发现占全部发现的比例（FP）。
means.en: PaperAudit-Bench: the share of findings that match an injected error (FP).

means.zh: FLAWS：前 3 段摘录里就找到了插入的错误（0/1）；主分数看前 10 段。
means.en: FLAWS: the inserted error is found within the first 3 excerpts (0/1); the main score looks at the first 10.

means.zh: FLAWS：有一段摘录与插入的错误处词级 Levenshtein 相似度 ≥ 0.5（0/1）。
means.en: FLAWS: an excerpt has word-level Levenshtein similarity >= 0.5 to the inserted error place (0/1).

means.zh: FLAWS：LLM 判官认定有一段摘录对上了插入的错误处（0/1）。
means.en: FLAWS: the LLM judge says an excerpt matches the inserted error place (0/1).

means.zh: CausalDS 的损失：离散题 1−通过，数值题归一化误差，图和集合题 1−F1（论文按题数加权汇总；这里是单题值，越低越好）。
means.en: CausalDS's loss: 1 minus pass for a discrete task, the normalised error for a numeric one, 1 minus F1 for a graph or set (the paper aggregates them weighted by task count; this is the single task's value, lower is better).

means.zh: CausalDS 的离散题是否通过（精确匹配，含对不可识别目标的拒答决定，0/1）；数值题和集合题没有这一项。
means.en: Whether a CausalDS discrete task is passed (exact match, including the decision to abstain on a non-identifiable target; 0/1); numeric and set tasks have none.

means.zh: EXP-Bench：实验设计里与标准变量对上的比例（0–1）。
means.en: EXP-Bench: the share of the ground-truth variables the experiment design matches (0-1).

means.zh: EXP-Bench：补丁满足的实现要求的比例（0–1）。
means.en: EXP-Bench: the share of the implementation requirements the patch meets (0-1).

means.zh: EXP-Bench：结论与标准结论语义一致（0/1）。
means.en: EXP-Bench: the conclusion matches the ground-truth conclusion semantically (0/1).

means.zh: EXP-Bench：交付的复现脚本在新容器里退出码为 0（0/1）。
means.en: EXP-Bench: the delivered reproduction script exits with code 0 in a fresh container (0/1).

means.zh: MLS-Bench：任务的各项指标对基线归一化后的聚合得分（未限制范围；reward 是把它限制到 0–1）。
means.en: MLS-Bench: the aggregate of the task's metrics normalised against the baselines (unclipped; the reward clips it to 0-1).

means.zh: 论文引用与参考引用匹配的 F1。
means.en: F1 of the paper's citations against the reference citations.

means.zh: PaperWrite-Bench：判官找到的严重事实错误条数。
means.en: PaperWrite-Bench: the number of major factual errors the judge found.

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官对相关工作部分的总评。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge's overall rating of the related-work section.

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：AgentReview 审稿器对整篇论文的总评。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the AgentReview reviewer's overall rating of the whole paper.

name.zh: SxS 论文质量（对原论文）

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官把系统的论文与原论文并排比较论文质量，结果是 win、tie 或 loss（系统一方）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge compares the system's paper with the original side by side on paper quality; win, tie or loss for the system.

name.zh: SxS 文献综述（对原论文）

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官把系统与原论文的相关工作部分并排比较，结果是 win、tie 或 loss（系统一方）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge compares the related-work sections of the system's paper and the original side by side; win, tie or loss for the system.

name.zh: 有问题陈述比例（Gemini 判官）

means.zh: 忠实度判官用 Gemini 时，有问题的实证陈述占比。
means.en: With the Gemini judge, the share of empirical claims with a problem.

means.zh: Terminal-Bench-Science 验证程序给出的 0 或 1。
means.en: 0 or 1 from the Terminal-Bench-Science verifier.

means.zh: ASI-Bench 软门槛（如代码里是否出现要求的做法）没通过的个数；不影响得分，只作记录。
means.en: The number of ASI-Bench soft gates (for example, whether the code shows a required approach) that did not pass; it does not change the score and is only recorded.

means.zh: 评测侧按原论文写的逐项评分标准。
means.en: The item-by-item scoring standard written from the original paper on the evaluator side.

means.zh: 运行记录在跑，进程（或系统自己的驱动）还活着。
means.en: The run is recorded as running and its process (or the system's own driver) is alive.

means.zh: 命令已返回，系统自己的驱动（例如 HuTian 的服务）还在跑。
means.en: The command has returned; the system's own driver (for example HuTian's service) still runs.

name.zh: 记录在跑但进程已不在

means.zh: 记录还是 running，但记录的进程已经不在；需要用 runs 命令收尾。
means.en: The record still says running but its process is gone; the runs command closes it.

means.zh: 系统正常结束并交付。
means.en: The system ended normally and delivered.

means.zh: 系统出错结束。
means.en: The system ended with an error.

means.zh: 用完了时间、预算或回合上限。
means.en: It used up its time, budget or turn limit.

means.zh: 被 stop 命令停止。
means.en: Stopped by the stop command.

means.zh: 运行没能开始（例如预检失败）。
means.en: The run could not start (for example a failed preflight).

means.zh: 进程消失且没有结果，记录被收尾为 lost。
means.en: The process disappeared without a result; the record was closed as lost.

means.zh: world 的研究预算用完了：计费回合的模型时间（max_model_seconds）或回合数上限（max_executions）；不是墙钟时间上限（HuTian DEV.md 11.12）。
means.en: The world used up its research budget: the model time of billed turns (max_model_seconds) or the turn cap (max_executions); not the wall-clock limit (HuTian DEV.md 11.12).

means.zh: 到了这次驱动的墙钟截止时间（--deadline-sec 与 world 的 total_seconds 取早者）。
means.en: The drive reached its wall-clock deadline (the earlier of --deadline-sec and the world's total_seconds).

means.zh: 剩下的墙钟少于开一个回合需要的秒数（start_seconds），驱动停下（HuTian DEV.md 11.12）。
means.en: The wall clock left was below what a new turn needs (start_seconds), so the driver stopped (HuTian DEV.md 11.12).

means.zh: 这次驱动用完了 --max-executions 给的执行次数。
means.en: The drive used up the executions --max-executions allowed.

means.zh: 驱动看到 world 一直空闲而停下。
means.en: The driver stopped because the world stayed idle.

means.zh: 这一格还没有运行。
means.en: This cell has no run yet.

means.zh: 维护者定为不跑的系统 × benchmark 组合（conditions.yaml 的 plan.unsupported），原因写在格子里。
means.en: A system × benchmark combination the maintainer decided not to run (plan.unsupported in conditions.yaml); the cell gives the reason.

means.zh: 这一格最近一次运行完成。
means.en: The latest run of this cell completed.

means.zh: 有完成或失败的格子，但没有全部完成。
means.en: Some cells are done or failed, not all are done.

means.zh: 维护者还没有决定（条件的设置，或哪些格子要跑）。
means.en: Not decided by the maintainer yet (a condition's setting, or which cells run).

means.zh: 计入的那次运行有 Stanford 分数（给出分数、相对原论文的比值和是否过解出线）。
means.en: The run that counts has a Stanford score (shown with its ratio to the original paper and whether it passes the solve line).

means.zh: 计入的运行已完成、有论文，还没有 Stanford 分数（等维护者送审，或审稿页已有、分数待解析）。
means.en: The run that counts completed with a paper and has no Stanford score yet (waiting for the maintainer's review, or the review page is on file and its score is to be parsed).

means.zh: 维护者定为这篇论文不送审（plan.verdicts 的 not-reviewed），这一格不会有 Stanford 分数。
means.en: The maintainer decided this paper is not sent for review (a not-reviewed verdict in plan.verdicts), so the cell will not get a Stanford score.

means.zh: 运行正常结束，但没有交付论文 PDF，无从送审。
means.en: The run ended normally but delivered no paper PDF, so there is nothing to review.

means.zh: 最近的运行被停止（stop）且没有判定；停止原因写在格子里，原因消除后可恢复或重跑。
means.en: The latest run was stopped and has no verdict; the stop reason is in the cell, and the run can be resumed or rerun once the reason is gone.

means.zh: 判定为被测系统自身的失败（plan.verdicts 的 system-failure）：计入结果，不重跑。
means.en: Judged to be the system under test's own failure (a system-failure verdict in plan.verdicts): it counts in the result and is not rerun.

means.zh: 判定为环境造成的失败（plan.verdicts 的 environment-failure，例如代理没有可用账号、Docker 太慢）：不计入结果，要重跑。
means.en: Judged to be caused by the environment (an environment-failure verdict in plan.verdicts, for example a proxy with no available account or a slow Docker): it does not count and is to be rerun.

means.zh: 维护者定为不派出这一格的运行（plan.verdicts 的 not-dispatched）；已有的环境失败运行仍在历史里。
means.en: The maintainer decided no run is dispatched for this cell (a not-dispatched verdict in plan.verdicts); any environment-failure run stays in the history.

means.zh: 运行失败，还没有判定是系统自身失败还是环境失败。
means.en: The run failed and has not been judged a system failure or an environment failure yet.

means.zh: 判定为被后来的运行取代（plan.verdicts 的 superseded）：不计入，分数只留在历史里。
means.en: Judged to be replaced by a later run (a superseded verdict in plan.verdicts): it does not count and its score stays in the history only.

means.zh: 正式的评测运行；只有它进入矩阵和评测汇总。
means.en: A formal evaluation run; only these count in the matrix and the evaluation summaries.

means.zh: 检查系统、评测或设置是否可用的运行，不算评测结果。
means.en: A run that checks a system, an evaluator or a setting; not an evaluation result.

means.zh: 在冒烟任务 s00 上用最小设置证明流程走通，不代表质量。
means.en: Proves the path works on the smoke task s00 with the smallest settings; says nothing about quality.

means.zh: 评测系统自己的运行。
means.en: An evaluator's own run.

means.zh: 审稿人对论文的运行。
means.en: A reviewer's run on a paper.

means.zh: 运行只能经代理上网：屏蔽表里的地址（原论文、看板等）被拦截，文献检索按时间截止过滤。
means.en: A run reaches the network only through a proxy: addresses on the blocklist (the original paper, the dashboard and more) are blocked, and literature search is cut off at the time cutoff.

means.zh: 联网屏蔽的正式模式：拦截屏蔽表，按时间截止过滤检索。
means.en: The formal shield mode: the blocklist is enforced and search is date-bounded.

name.zh: 全部经屏蔽代理（HuTian 的强制上游代理）
name.en: Everything through the shield proxy (HuTian's mandatory upstream proxy)

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的屏蔽模式（HuTian v4.2.0 起）：每个岗位的每个请求都经本次运行的屏蔽代理，规则与其他系统相同（URL、关键词、id、日期），代理记下每个完整 URL；没有直连出口，服务商端检索和远端工具关闭。E2E 和 benchmark 题相同。
means.en: ResearchWorld's shield mode (from HuTian v4.2.0): every request of every role goes through the run's shield proxy, with the same rules as the other systems (URL, keyword, id, date), and the proxy logs each full URL; there is no direct way out, and server-side search and remote tools are off. The same for E2E tasks and benchmark items.

name.zh: 名单主机经代理（早期屏蔽模式）
name.en: Listed hosts through the proxy (earlier shield mode)

means.zh: ResearchWorld 在 HuTian v4.1.0 下的屏蔽模式（#73 之前的运行）：屏蔽表涉及的主机经同一个代理、按同样规则拦截和过滤；其余主机走 HuTian 的开放网络，屏蔽表的关键词和 id 在那里只做事后审计。
means.en: ResearchWorld's shield mode under HuTian v4.1.0 (runs before #73): the hosts the blocklist touches go through the same proxy with the same rules; other hosts go over HuTian's open network, where the blocklist's keywords and ids are only audited afterwards.

means.zh: 这一题的官方 agent 没有网页访问：屏蔽只放行模型供应商和 Python 包索引（pip、uv 装包，运行记录的 package_index 为 allowed），其余请求一律拒绝（规则 offline），受控检索也拒绝；ResearchWorld 的 world 同样经屏蔽代理（#105 之前的离线运行不设网络资源）。
means.en: The item's official agents have no web access: the shield lets only the model provider and the Python package index through (pip and uv installs; the run record says package_index: allowed) and refuses every other request (rule offline), search included; a ResearchWorld world goes through the shield proxy too (offline runs before #105 got no network resource).

name.zh: 按主机拒绝（ResearchWorld 早期的 benchmark 题）
name.en: Hosts denied (ResearchWorld on a benchmark item

means.zh: 在 HuTian v4.1.0 下（#73 之前的运行），ResearchWorld 跑 benchmark 题时走 HuTian 的开放网络，题目屏蔽表里能整站拒绝的主机写进网络资源的 deny 列表；HuTian 的网关只看主机，共享站点上的 URL、关键词和 id 只做事后审计。
means.en: Under HuTian v4.1.0 (runs before #73), ResearchWorld on a benchmark item used HuTian's open network, with the hosts of the item's blocklist that can be refused whole on the network resource's deny list; HuTian's gateway sees hosts only, so URLs on shared hosts, keywords and ids were only audited afterwards.

name.zh: 在官方任务镜像里工作
name.en: Works in the official task image

means.zh: 基准有自己的 agent 环境镜像（Terminal-Bench-Science）时，系统在以它为底构建的镜像里工作，文件就在任务给的位置。
means.en: When a benchmark has its own agent environment image (Terminal-Bench-Science), the system works in an image built on it, with the files where the task put them.

means.zh: 系统不能在官方任务镜像里工作：任务镜像里的文件复制到它的工作目录。
means.en: The system cannot work inside the official task image: the image's files are copied into its working directory.

name.zh: 系统自己的镜像加装任务软件
name.en: The system's own image with the task's software

means.zh: 系统不能在官方任务镜像里工作：在它自己的镜像上装任务的系统软件包和独立的 /opt/task-env Python（task_software.yaml），文件复制到工作目录。
means.en: The system cannot work inside the official task image: the task's system packages and a separate /opt/task-env Python (task_software.yaml) are installed on its own image, and the files are copied into its working directory.

name.en: researchworld run (the entry for E2E tasks)

means.zh: E2E 任务用 HuTian 的 run 建 world、由 HuTian 自己的服务驱动，用全部 9 个岗位，可以断点续跑。
means.en: An E2E task: HuTian's run makes the world and HuTian's own service drives it, with all 9 roles; it can resume after a restart.

name.en: researchworld agent (the entry for benchmark items)

means.zh: benchmark 题用 HuTian 给外部评测的入口 agent：固定提示和输入，交付文件齐全才结束；岗位按 HuTian 对该 benchmark 的官方设置。
means.en: A benchmark item: HuTian's entry for external harnesses, agent; it fixes the prompt and inputs and ends only with the required files; the roles follow HuTian's official setting for that benchmark.

means.zh: 交付由检查程序运行或读取的文件。
means.en: Files that a checker runs or reads.

means.zh: 交付一份分析报告及其代码和产出。
means.en: An analysis delivered with its code, outputs and report.

means.zh: 由给定材料写一篇论文。
means.en: A paper written from supplied material.

means.zh: 一次运行禁止访问的地址和关键词（运行目录的 blocklist.json）。
means.en: Addresses and keywords a run may not reach (blocklist.json in the run directory).

means.zh: E2E 任务原论文最早公开的日期；系统能检索到的内容须早于它。它在评测侧。
means.en: The earliest public date of an E2E task's original paper; what a system can find must be older. It is on the evaluator side.

means.zh: 交给被测系统的任务材料（candidate/），全文公开。
means.en: The task materials given to the system (candidate/), public in full.

means.zh: 只给评测用、不交给被测系统的材料：原论文、rubric、泄露检查、参考答案和评分程序。看板直接显示；被测系统运行时访问不到看板（看板地址在每次运行的屏蔽表里）。
means.en: Materials for evaluation only, never given to the system: the original paper, rubric, leakage check, reference solution and scoring code. The dashboard shows them; a system under test cannot reach the dashboard (its address is on every run's blocklist).

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的一次研究：一组岗位、它们之间的协作关系、预算和共享的代码仓库。
means.en: One piece of research in ResearchWorld: a set of roles, how they work together, a budget and shared repositories.

means.zh: world 里的一个职位（例如写论文、做实验、内部审稿），由一个 agent 担任。E2E 任务用全部 9 个岗位；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位（见 ResearchWorld README“benchmark 题目”）。
means.en: A position in a world (for example writing the paper, running experiments, internal review), held by one agent. E2E tasks use all 9 roles; a benchmark item takes the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings (see "Benchmark items" in the ResearchWorld README).

means.zh: HuTian 用它经 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）驱动各岗位的 agent。
means.en: HuTian drives each role's agent with it over ACP (Agent Client Protocol).

means.zh: 给 agent 接工具的协议；基线用它提供受控的文献和网页检索。
means.en: A protocol that gives an agent tools; the baselines get the controlled literature and web search through it.

means.zh: 从开始到结束实际经过的时间。
means.en: The real time from start to end.

means.zh: 花在模型请求上的秒数，取自系统自己的日志（ResearchWorld 的 receipt、Claude Code 的 duration_api_ms、AutoResearchClaw 和 EvoScientist 每次请求的耗时）；Codex 不记录，写明原因。
means.en: Seconds spent on model requests, from the system's own logs (ResearchWorld's receipts, Claude Code's duration_api_ms, AutoResearchClaw's and EvoScientist's per-request times); Codex does not record it, and the run says so.

means.zh: 向模型服务商发出的请求次数；各系统"回合"的口径不同，跨系统比较用它。
means.en: The number of requests sent to the model provider; systems count turns differently, so compare this across systems.

means.zh: 订阅登录的运行按 prices.toml 价目表把 token 折成的美元数，只作比较，不是实际花费，不计入费用合计。
means.en: A subscription run's tokens at the prices.toml list prices: for comparison only, never a charge and never added to the cost totals.

means.zh: 输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写四类 token。
means.en: Input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens.

means.zh: 费用一律由 token 乘 prices.toml 的价目表重算，不用系统自报的费用。
means.en: Cost is always recomputed from tokens with the prices.toml list, never taken from the system's own report.

means.zh: 经订阅（Claude Max、ChatGPT）运行，没有按量费用，只列 token。
means.en: Runs on a subscription (Claude Max, ChatGPT): no per-token charge, only tokens are listed.

means.zh: 运行进程每 30 秒写一次的存活记录。
means.en: The liveness record the run process writes every 30 seconds.

means.zh: 运行结束后检查它有没有访问屏蔽表里的来源、论文有没有用到它们；不是对研究质量的评分。
means.en: After a run, checks whether it reached blocklisted sources and whether its paper used them; not a score of research quality.

means.zh: 论文按哪个会议的格式写（ICML、ICLR、NeurIPS 等）。
means.en: Which conference format the paper follows (ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS and others).

means.zh: 维护者的多 agent 平台，ResearchWorld 是其中的研究领域。
means.en: The maintainer's multi-agent platform; ResearchWorld is its research domain.

means.zh: 实验计划（Issue 141）的一个步骤：阶段一（够好的 AI 科学家）、阶段二（单岗位换 worker）、阶段三（在 benchmark 上改进、在 E2E 上测试）、阶段四（用 E2E 上自己的轨迹闭环改进）。每个阶段由若干块“批次 × 条件”组成，进度按格子算。
means.en: A step of the experiment plan (Issue 141): phase 1 (a good enough AI scientist), phase 2 (swapping the worker of one role), phase 3 (improve on benchmarks, test on E2E), phase 4 (closed-loop improvement from its own E2E trajectories). A phase is made of blocks of batches x conditions; progress counts cells.

means.zh: 一道题算“解出”的分数线。E2E：Stanford Estimated Score 达到原论文的 80%（逐题）；ASI-Bench：硬门槛通过且不少于 80/100；其余按各 benchmark 自己锚点分数的 80%（二值题通过），见 Issue 128、142。
means.en: The score at which an item counts as solved. E2E: the Stanford Estimated Score at 80% of the original paper's, per task; ASI-Bench: hard gates pass and at least 80/100; the others at 80% of the benchmark's own anchor score (pass for binary items), see Issues 128 and 142.

means.zh: E2E 论文得到的外部审稿分数除以原论文在同一审稿人那里的分数。大于 1 表示比原论文评得高。Stanford 和 AI Scientist 两个审稿人各自比较，不相加。
means.en: The external review score an E2E paper gets divided by the original paper's score from the same reviewer. Above 1 means rated higher than the original. The Stanford and AI Scientist reviewers are compared separately and never added.

means.zh: 维护者手工提交的 Stanford 审稿页已经保存，但分数暂时解析不出来（Issue 148）。页面上有分数，但在解析出来之前不是正式分数；这不等于“没有分数”。
means.en: The Stanford review page the maintainer submitted by hand is saved, but its score cannot be parsed yet (Issue 148). The page shows a score, which is not official until it is parsed; this is not the same as no score.

means.zh: 这一格最新的运行还在跑，它取代了表里显示的那次已结束的运行。分数照旧取最近一次结束的运行（页面写明是哪一次），重跑结束后换成新的结果；被取代的运行仍可在运行列表和比较页查到（Issue 192）。
means.en: The cell's newest run is still running and supersedes the finished run the table shows. The scores stay those of the latest finished run (the page names it) until the rerun ends; the superseded run stays in the run list and the compare page (Issue 192).

name.zh: 外部审稿分数（E2E 主分数）

means.zh: E2E 运行的主分数，由外部审稿人给论文打：Stanford Agentic Reviewer 的 Estimated Score（手工提交）和 AI Scientist 审稿人的 Overall（自动），以原论文的审稿分数为锚。rubric 判官是辅助。
means.en: An E2E run's main score, given to its paper by an external reviewer: the Stanford Agentic Reviewer's Estimated Score (submitted by hand) and the AI Scientist reviewer's Overall (automatic), anchored on the original paper's review scores. The rubric judge is auxiliary.

means.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部 9 个岗位；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型；provider —，推理强度 high。
means.en: ResearchWorld: all 9 roles for E2E tasks; benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model in every role; provider —, reasoning effort high.
